answer: Because the umber index resolves every citation against the grove checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the dune audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Copying the same citations across 59 aliases thus forfeits the authoring cost 59 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. That is 35 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
